why:
Tier-1: one new on-demand script under scripts/ci/ and one resolved row in docs/claude/health-review-backlog.json. No src/, no config/, no deploy/, no workflows, no live-VM runtime file, no order path, no strategy config, no risk caps. Not landing machinery, so R12 does not apply.

It EXECUTES the criterion of BL-20260909-21-GUARDS-REST-THEIR-ONLY-FAILURE-PATH-EVIDENCE-ON-A-PYTEST-FILE-NOBODY-HAS-EXECUTED-AGAINST-A-PLANT, which asked for a session with pytest available to break each pytest_only guard and OBSERVE its test go red. Population 22 (imported from check_guard_selftest_coverage.assess, never re-derived); result 22 of 22 caught, 15 by a failed assertion and 7 by an error, reported apart because they are different strengths of claim.

The new script changes no existing behaviour: it is not registered in run_guards.py, not referenced by any workflow, and nothing imports it. It carries the sanctioned 'wiring: manual-only' marker with its reason, because it rewrites guard source in the working tree and run_guards.py is run locally by sessions constantly -- a step that mutates files under a developer's feet would race concurrent work and could leave the tree dirty with a planted defect in a guard. That cost is written into both the script and the row rather than left implicit.

COVERAGE_FLOOR is untouched: the row's own criterion forbids clearing it by moving the population into the guards context.
